instruction: Change the playback speed of the video to slow motion (0.5x speed) using VLC's playback controls.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing playback speed in VLC to 0.5x slow motion (Playback > Speed or use keyboard shortcuts like '[' or ']'). The evaluator queries VLC's HTTP interface to check if playback rate is 0.5.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC playback speed from HTTP interface using XML parsing
Metric correctly compares result against expected speed value (0.5) with appropriate tolerance (0.01)
Expected configuration correctly uses type='rule' with rules={'speed': 0.5}
Parameter handling is correct: metric accesses expected.get('speed', 0.5) which properly receives the rules dict when type='rule'
Complete coverage: instruction requires 0.5x speed and evaluator verifies speed == 0.5 (within tolerance)
Logic is semantically sound and will correctly distinguish between correct (0.5x) and incorrect speeds
